Keyboard

Press U, D, L, R, F, B, M, E, or S. Shift gives inverse. Alt gives a double turn.

How to Play

Solve the cube by returning every face to one solid color.

  • Drag directly on a visible sticker to twist that layer.
  • Drag empty space around the cube to orbit the camera.
  • On touch screens, use one finger on stickers to twist and two fingers to zoom or orbit.
  • Moves use standard notation: U up, D down, L left, R right, F front, B back.
  • Middle-slice moves are M middle, E equator, and S standing.
  • Keyboard moves use U, D, L, R, F, B, M, E, and S. Hold Shift for inverse moves.
  • Scramble uses legal moves, Reset returns to solved, and Undo reverses your latest move.
